description: Gives a test member credits in Development, at once with no approval — the same credits the dashboard gives, on their credit history with the note. Test members only (made with test_member_add); anyone else is refused, and it never reaches Live — Live's customers get credits through request_grant_credits, approved by the founder. amount is whole credits (1–100,000); note is one line saying why. A second call gives them again. On the founder's Logs.

note.description: one line saying why, up to 200 characters

name: test_member_credits
title: Give a test member credits
